raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "cost"
  role subject "Dacia Jogger Extreme"
  role object "approximately 21,900 euros"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "plan to pay"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "a 20 percent down payment"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@a2 assumed
  relation "plan for"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "a 60 month leasing term"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  select ?opt
  where match
    relation "be the most advantageous leasing option"
    role subject ?opt
    polarity affirmed
  end
